title: Storey Architecture note card
description: A small off-white paper card pinned with a paperclip: a two-line mono heading and the wordmark at the top, a handwritten-style line on the first of six ruled lines, and three mono labels along the bottom. Sized in em, so one font-size scales the whole card; tilt it with a rotate class.
notes: set its size with a text-[…] class on className (22em wide); 1vw matches the original at desktop
the handwritten line uses the body face in italic (no script token)
